title: Reply in the customer's profile language, not the message's language

customer_request.text: Hey, what's happening with order TW-2026-13242? Running late for me today.

notes_for_instructor: CUST-5172's profile locale is 'ar' (customers_seed.json) but this particular message is written in English — customer_request.locale carries the CUSTOMER's stated locale for this scenario (ar), and the reply must match it, not the incidental script of one message (code-switching is common and must not flip the reply language).
